content.text:
I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `5693016` with the message `2025-12: add rows`. `scripts/check.sh` printed OK before the commit. The file adds 32 lines.

The first commit attempt didn't go through, so I ran `git add` and `git commit` again. The log shows only one new commit.

The check only tests that each row has the same number of fields as the header. It doesn't check values. Row `R2512-003` has the category `wholsale`, which looks like a typo for `wholesale`. I left it as it was. I didn't check whether other rows or earlier months use the same spelling, because my command for counting categories was denied.

The original is still in `inbox/`, since I copied it rather than moved it.
